主要内容: On March 21, 2013, SAP AG, a German-based company, announced its decision to propose a dividend of €0.85 per share for the fiscal year 2012. This decision was made by the Supervisory Board following the recommendation of the Executive Board. The announcement was included in a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 6-K filing. The document also includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to various risks and uncertainties. SAP emphasized that these statements are based on current expectations and are not guaranteed. The company also noted that readers should not place undue reliance on these statements, as they are only valid as of their respective dates.
